instruction: 听全部五段材料，按2题、3题、3题、3题、4题的顺序完成全部15题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后各按每题5秒留时。审阅可重播，非正式次数控制。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The stepping stones look slippery after the rain. Shall we cancel the garden visit?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: We can use the gravel path instead. It is a little longer, but it goes to the same gate.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That sounds better. I will tell the group to follow that route.

questions.rationale: A：明确雨后石头滑；B：没说门锁；C：无迟到
A：同意改路非取消；B：改用砂砾路；C：未延期

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Have you found all the costumes for the play?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Almost. We have enough coats, but we need two more hats. I asked the theatre shop, but hiring them is expensive.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Could we make them from cardboard?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I tried that yesterday. They looked good under the stage lights, so I will make the second one this evening.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I can help. What should I bring?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Some strong tape. We have plenty of paint already.

questions.rationale: A：外套够用；B：颜料够用；C：两顶缺帽已做一顶还差一顶

questions.stem: Why did the woman reject hiring hats?
questions.rationale: A：明确租金贵；B：未关门；C：未试尺寸
A：未要求他带纸板；B：明确胶带；C：舞台灯已有

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Your cake is much smaller than last year's. Did you change the recipe?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No. I used the same ingredients, but made only half the amount. There were too many leftovers last time.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That makes sense. Does it still have nuts?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. I will put a clear label beside it. There is a separate fruit plate for anyone who cannot eat nuts.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I can write the label while you cut the cake.

questions.stem: Why did the man make a smaller cake?
questions.rationale: A：没说烤箱坏；B：食材未缺只是减量；C：上次剩太多
A：明确仍有坚果；B：未说奶酪；C：未说咖啡
A：水果盘已备；B：明确写标签；C：不改食谱；虚构食品场景不作个体过敏判断

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The walking club wants a map with every footpath on it.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: That could be difficult to read. Most visitors only need the route between the station and the lake.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: So you think we should simplify it?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. Keep the main route, the toilets and the bus stops. We can provide a link to a detailed map for people who want more.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. I will remove the minor paths and enlarge the labels.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then print one copy first, so we can test whether the names are readable.

questions.stem: What is the woman concerned about?
options: The map being hard to read.
questions.rationale: A：无车票价格；B：细路太多会难读；C：不是路线过长
A：明确保留；B：明确保留；C：男方同意去掉小路

options: To sell it at the station.
questions.rationale: A：试读标签是否清楚；B：未售卖；C：详细在线图仍保留

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: This Friday our class will run a second-hand puzzle stall outside the library. We are collecting complete puzzles only. Before donating one, please count the pieces and put them in a sealed bag inside the box. If pieces are missing, keep that puzzle at home; a picture of the finished puzzle cannot replace missing pieces. Bring donations to Room Six by Wednesday afternoon. Volunteers will price the puzzles on Thursday. Most will cost between two and five pounds. The stall opens at twelve thirty and closes at two. The money will buy new cushions for the library reading corner. Please do not arrive early expecting to buy the best puzzles before the stall opens: helpers will be arranging the tables, and no sales will be made before twelve thirty. Any unsold puzzles will be offered to the after-school club, with the owner's permission.

questions.rationale: A：图片不能补缺片；B：明确只收完整拼图；C：允许二手
A：明确周三下午前；B：周四定价；C：周五销售

questions.stem: What will the money be used for?
questions.rationale: A：非买拼图；B：非修桌；C：明确图书角新坐垫

questions.stem: What will happen before 12:30 on Friday?
options: There will be an early sale.
questions.rationale: A：明确不提前卖；B：志愿者布置桌子；C：未售拼图在销售后再处理
